payload.friendly_name: command-cli: the runnable events write service and its native release
payload.purpose_context: Core's CLI must reach one write service per repository through a fail-closed launcher. This mission builds that service's process lifecycle, its loopback protocol surface and its per-OS release, so core can pin and launch it; the canonical writer and the lane authority follow in #160 and #161.
payload.purpose_tldr: Ship the events write service as a runnable, pinnable native binary and jar that core can launch, with writes refusing until the write core lands.

options: runnable service + release only (write core in new issues)
payload.question: Does this mission deliver the whole write core, or only the runnable service and its release with writes refusing fail-closed?

payload.final_answer: runnable service + release only (write core in new issues #160, #161); operator ruling 2026-10-31

payload.wp_title: Lifecycle: start, shutdown, idle and signal exit, process tests
HTTP edge: bind, guard, token, protocol, size, problems
On-disk process surface: state dir, lock, endpoint file, token, identity
Native build, CI matrix and release assets
Module skeleton, build and command line
